plugins.description: Updates and plugin management UI for the DeepSeek Harness Windows desktop app: a sidebar entry, a panel and a Settings section, driven by the app's native bridge.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-desktop-updates

**A DeepSeek Harness plugin that renders the Updates UI of the Windows desktop app: a row beside Settings, an Updates panel, and an Updates section, driven by the app's native page bridge.**

![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)
![platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Web%20UI-1f6feb)
![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.1.x-1f6feb)
![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-desktop-updates)
![status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-maintained%20for%20an%20archived%20app-orange)

It shows the desktop app's version, the installed and published harness versions, and the plugins this home
runs — with the actions to check, download, install, restart, repair the harness, and enable, disable, install
or remove plugins.

> **Project status:** 1.3.0, published on npm. Verified against the DeepSeek Harness **0.1.5-rc.x** runtime
> that the Windows desktop app bundles. **The desktop app it serves is archived**, and this plugin depends on
> that app's own page bridge (`window.__dshDesktop`), which the official DeepSeek Harness desktop app does not
> provide. In the official app the plugin loads and renders, but reports that the bridge is unavailable —
> because it is. See §Why this exists.

## Screenshots

The UI appears in the desktop app that bundles it. Screenshots of the app window, including the Updates panel,
are in
[the app repository](https://github.com/desanv01/deepseek-harness-desktop-app#screenshots).

## Why this exists

The app needed a settings surface — the app's version, whether the harness was current, what plugins this home
runs, and buttons to act on all of it — without rebuilding a native window for every change. The app already
rendered the harness web UI in WebView2, so the surface became a plugin: sidebar row, panel and Settings
section, all in the page the user is already looking at.

That decision had one consequence worth stating. The facts and the actions live in the **app**, not the page,
so the page needs a channel back to it. The app injects a versioned bridge, `window.__dshDesktop`, into every
page it loads, and this plugin is the only consumer of it.

**That bridge is the reason this plugin is tied to one app.** The official DeepSeek Harness desktop app ships
its own plugin manager and its own updates view; it does not expose `__dshDesktop`. Installed there, this plugin
registers its slots and then reports that it cannot reach the app — which is accurate, and better than a panel
that looks live and does nothing.

## What it does

- **A row beside Settings** in the sidebar — a labelled entry (an icon in the 56 px rail) that opens the Updates
  panel, with a dot when a newer app build exists.
- **A panel**, full view, in the app's own window: the facts plus check, download, install, restart and
  repair, and the plugin list with enable, disable, install and remove.
- **A Settings section** with the same facts and actions in a narrower form.
- **Reports what the shell refused.** The shell drops a slot registration it dislikes without telling anyone, so
  a plugin whose UI never appears looks exactly like one that never loaded. This plugin publishes what it
  registered — and every refusal — to `window.__dshDesktopUpdates` and to the app's log.
- **Degrades honestly.** With no bridge, it says the app is unavailable instead of pretending the panel works.

## How it works

### The four slots it contributes

| Slot | Entry | What it renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sidebar.footer.action` | id `desktop-updates` | A labelled row beside Settings (an icon in the 56 px rail) that opens the Updates panel; a dot when a newer app build exists |
| `sidebar.panellist` | id `desktop-updates` | The sidebar row for the Updates panel, addressed by the same id as the body below |
| `main` | key `desktop-updates` | The Updates panel itself: the full view, in the app's own window |
| `settings.section` | id `desktop-updates` | The concise view inside Settings, with the same facts and actions |

The three list slots require an `id` and the keyed `main` slot requires a `key`; the shell rejects a
registration that omits either.

### Opening the panel is a layout action, not a bridge call

The plugin selects its own panel through `ctx.layout.selectPanel`, so the view appears in the window the user
is already looking at, and opening it cannot fail because the bridge is unavailable. When the shell has no
panel slot to select, it falls back to the app's native updates window — the same window the tray menu opens.

### The registration marker

`client.js` writes `window.__dshDesktopUpdates` as it applies: the slots it registered and every contribution
the shell refused. The app reads that marker after each page load and logs it. The Updates section repeats any
refusal, because that is the only place a user would see it.

### Version skew

The app leaves an installed version alone when it is newer than the copy inside its executable, so a newer npm
release is not undone by the next launch. `DeepSeekHarness.exe --install-plugin` restores the bundled copy
deliberately.

## Requirements

- A DeepSeek Harness **0.1.x** composition with the `layout` service — the runtime the Windows desktop app
  bundles.
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout`, declared in `dsh.client.inject`, which the host must provide.
- For anything to be actionable: the desktop app's `window.__dshDesktop` bridge.

## Quick start

### Install from npm

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-desktop-updates
```

### Install into the desktop app

The app installs its bundled copy by itself, into the harness home it owns. From inside the app, use
**Settings → Updates → the plugin manager**, which accepts a package name, a git spec or a local folder.
Installing from npm replaces the bundled copy with the published one.

### Build from source

Nothing to build — the client half is a hand-written module-face bundle:

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/desanv01/dsh-plugin-desktop-updates.git
cd dsh-plugin-desktop-updates
dsh plugin --profile web add .
```

### Smoke test

The client half can be rendered headlessly against a fake shell; that is how the desktop app's own CI checks
it, with `tools/client-plugin-smoke.mjs` in
[the app repository](https://github.com/desanv01/deepseek-harness-desktop-app). It loads the real `client.js`,
enforces the real slot rules (a list entry needs an `id`, the panel slot needs a `key`) and fails if a
registration is dropped.

## Configuration

None. The plugin reads no `Config` values; it renders what the bridge reports.

## Slots used

See the four-slot table in §How it works. `main` is keyed; the other three are addressed by `id`.

## Where things live

| Piece | Path |
| --- | --- |
| Host half | `index.js` — an empty `apply`, so the row exists in the profile's bundle stack and the loader keeps it |
| Browser half | `client.js` — a module-face bundle (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`) |
| Loader row | `cordis.patch.yml` — inserts the row `desktop-updates` |
| Registration marker | `window.__dshDesktopUpdates`, plus the app's log |
| Bridge it consumes | `window.__dshDesktop`, injected by the app |

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| No sidebar row at all | The bundle row is missing from the profile, or the client half was not served | Check `cordis.patch.yml` is installed, then read `window.__dshDesktopUpdates` in the page |
| Row appears, panel says the app is unavailable | No `window.__dshDesktop` — this is the expected result outside the Windows desktop app | Use the app that provides the bridge |
| Row appears, panel is empty | The bridge exists but reported no state | Check the app's log for the marker it logs after each page load |
| Settings section missing but the panel works | The shell refused the `settings.section` registration | The section repeats refusals; the marker lists them |
| A newer npm version did not take effect | The app keeps an installed version newer than its bundled copy | See §Version skew |

## Current status

Working, for the app it was built for.

Verified: the four slot registrations

plugins.description: DSH 侧栏用量插件：WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy 每日 Token、积分、按模型单价与账号剩余额度
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workbuddy-usage

在 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)（DSH Desktop）**左侧栏底部**加一行原生风格的「使用量」条目，点开是 Codex 统计风格的用量面板 —— 每日 Token、积分消耗、缓存命中、按模型单价、账号剩余额度，一屏看完。

> 数据来自 workbuddy2api / CodeBuddy 兼容网关自带的面板接口（`/panel/api/usage`、`/panel/api/overview`），插件只读，不改动网关。

![侧栏条目](docs/sidebar-entry.png)

![面板](docs/panel.png)

## 功能

- **侧栏常驻条目**：`使用量 · 2467 万`，位于「远程控制」正上方；图标 + 文案 + 右对齐数值，沿用 DSH 原生行高（36px）、圆角、hover 色与折叠态（只留图标）。
- **计数单位**：Token 未破 1 亿一律按「万」（`948.1 万`），破亿按「亿」（`1.154 亿`），并自动处理 `10000 万 → 1 亿` 的进位。
- **区间切换**：今日 / 近 7 天 / 近 30 天 / 全部。
- **面板指标**：区间 Token 总量、请求数（含错误数、平均延迟）、积分（含每百万 Token 均价）、缓存命中率、输出速度、输入/输出占比条、时序柱状图。
- **按模型明细**：每个模型的请求数、Token 量，以及**每百万 tokens 的积分消耗**（`1.25 积分/M`；零消耗模型标「免费」）。
- **账号额度**：账号池总剩余 / 总额度进度条、可用 / 冷却 / 禁用数量、逐账号剩余额度迷你条与状态点，悬停可看冷却原因、最近使用模型、累计请求与套餐到期时间。
- **面板内设置**：标题栏右上角 **⚙** 直接改服务器地址与 API Key，保存后写回 config.json、清缓存并自动探活；同时注册到 DSH **设置页**的「WorkBuddy 用量」分区，两条路都能进。
- **自动刷新**：面板收起时 3 分钟、展开时 30 秒；标题栏右上角 **↻** 走 `refresh=1` 绕过缓存，刷新时图标旋转。
- **深/浅色自适应**：按祖先背景亮度自动切换色板，全部使用 DSH 设计 token（`--dsw-alias-*`、`--dsw-radius-*`）。

## 安装

### 1. 放置插件

```bash
git clone https://github.com/xiebrooooo/dsh-workbuddy-usage.git \
  ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-workbuddy-usage
```

（Windows 即 `C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\plugins\dsh-workbuddy-usage`）

### 2. 写配置（二选一）

**推荐：装好后在界面里填** —— 重启 DSH 后点侧栏「使用量」→ 面板右上角 ⚙（或打开 DSH 设置页 →「WorkBuddy 用量」），填写服务器地址与 API Key，点「保存并测试」。插件会把配置写进自己的 `config.json` 并立刻验证连通性，无需手改文件。

**或者：先手写配置文件**

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-workbuddy-usage
cp config.example.json config.json
# 编辑 config.json：填 baseUrl 与 apiKey
```

`config.json` 已被 `.gitignore` 忽略，不会误提交。

### 3. 挂进 profile

编辑 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json`：

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-workbuddy-usage": "file:../../plugins/dsh-workbuddy-usage"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
        "dsh-workbuddy-usage"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

然后在 profile 目录执行：

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm install
```

### 4. 重启 DSH Desktop

宿主半侧是 ESM 模块，改完**必须重启一次**才会加载；客户端半侧之后可热更新。

重启后左下角「远程控制」上方会出现「使用量」条目。

## 配置

`config.json`（可用环境变量 `WORKBUDDY_USAGE_BASE` / `WORKBUDDY_USAGE_KEY` 覆盖前两项）：

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | `http://127.0.0.1:7863` | 网关地址，含 scheme 与端口，不带尾斜杠 |
| `apiKey` | — | 面板 API Key（`Authorization: Bearer`） |
| `routePrefix` | `/dsh-workbuddy-usage` | 注册到 DSH webServer 的前缀路由 |
| `cacheTtlMs` | `25000` | 用量数据缓存 |
| `accountTtlMs` | `60000` | 账号额度缓存 |
| `timeoutMs` | `20000` | 上游请求超时 |

## 路由（由宿主半侧注册到 DSH 同源 webServer）

| 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `GET {routePrefix}/api/usage?scope=today\|7d\|30d\|all[&refresh=1]` | 用量 + `account` 账号数据 |
| `GET {routePrefix}/api/account[?refresh=1]` | 仅账号额度与状态 |
| `GET {routePrefix}/api/config` | 读取当前配置（**不返回 Key 明文**，只给 `hasApiKey` 与 `apiKeyHint`） |
| `POST {routePrefix}/api/config` | 保存 `{ baseUrl, apiKey?, timeoutMs? }`，写回 `config.json`、清缓存并立刻探活 |
| `GET {routePrefix}/api/ping` | 连通性 / 配置自检（不含 Key） |

### 为什么必须有宿主半侧

面板响应带 `Content-Security-Policy: connect-src 'self'`、`Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin`，且没有 `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`，浏览器无法直连。因此由宿主进程（Node）带 Bearer 拉取上游，再以**同源**前缀路由提供给渲染进程。

## 数据字段

上游 `by_model[]` / `totals` 每条记录会被规范化为：

```json
{
  "requests": 306, "errors": 3,
  "promptTokens": 28890000, "completionTokens": 209000, "totalTokens": 29095704,
  "credits": 45.99, "creditTokens": 29095704, "creditsPer1M": 1.58,
  "cacheHitTokens": 27750000, "cacheMissTokens": 1345704, "cacheHitRate": 96.1,
  "avgLatencyMs": 14394, "tokensPerSecond": 250
}
```

账号侧来自 `/panel/api/overview`：`totals{accounts,healthy,cooling,paused,disabled,credits,creditsTotal}` 与 `accounts[]{uid,nickname,realm,credits,creditsTotal,cooling,disabled,until,reason,lastModel,requests,totalTokens,earliestExpiry,earliestRemaining}`。

## 开发与调试

- 客户端 bundle 由宿主 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-hmr` 每 500ms 轮询 `mtime/size`，变化即重新发布并经 SSE `/plugins/events` 推送 —— **改 `client.js` 后无需重启 DSH**。
- 但 pnpm 对 `file:` 依赖是**复制**而不是软链：`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-workbuddy-usage/` 里是副本，**页面加载的是副本**。改完源码必须同步：

  ```bash
  cp client.js ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-workbuddy-usage/client.js
  ```

- 改 `index.js`（宿主半侧）没有热更新，重启 DSH 才生效。
- 快捷验证：`curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "http://127.0.0.1:7863/panel/api/usage?hours=24"`。

## 排错

| 现象 | 原因 / 处理 |
|---|---|
| 侧栏没有「使用量」 | profile `bundles` 未包含本包，或没执行 `pnpm install`，或没重启 DSH |
| 面板显示「上游 401」 | `apiKey` 与面板 `api_key` 不一致 |
| 面板显示「HTTP 404」 | 宿主半侧未加载（检查 bundles / 重启） |
| 改了界面没变化 | 忘了同步 `node_modules` 里的副本（见上） |
| 数字不更新 | 路由层有 25s 缓存，点标题栏右上角 **↻** 走 `refresh=1` |
| 「设置」保存后提示失败 / 404 | 宿主半侧改过代码但没重启 DSH（index.js 无热更新） |
| 账号额度区块不显示 | 宿主半侧未重启；或上游 `/panel/api/overview` 不可用（面板会显示原因） |

## 兼容性

- DSH Desktop 2.0.x（Web 客户端，`http://127.0.0.1:43120`）。
- 依赖的槽位：`sidebar.footer.action`（`order: 25`，原生「远程控制」为 `26`）、`settings.section`（`order: 120`）。
- 上游需提供 `/panel/api/usage` 与 `/panel/api/overview` 且支持 Bearer 鉴权（workbuddy2api 面板即满足）。

## 免责声明

第三方社区插件，与 DeepSeek / CodeBuddy 官方无关。插件只读取你自己网关的面板接口，不收集、不上传任何数据。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Marginal notes for DSH. Mark assistant replies in the conversation and keep them as notes.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-marginalia

在 DeepSeek Harness 的对话里，把值得留下的句子标出来，收成笔记，并就其中一句接着问。助手的回复和自己发出的内容都可以。问句开在旁边的侧栏里，主对话留在原来的页面。

Mark a sentence in a DeepSeek Harness conversation, keep it as a note, and ask about that sentence alone. This works on assistant replies and on messages you sent. The question opens in the side column. The main conversation stays where it is.

[中文说明](#中文) · [English](#english)

---

## 中文

这是 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版的一个插件。对话页上，「学习」和「对话」并列。空白的新对话不显示这排标签。

你留在对话里，选中助手写给你的一段话，或自己发出的一段话。光标右上方会出现一张白卡片，右键打开的是同一张。卡片上有五件事：

| 按钮 | 做什么 |
|---|---|
| 复制 | 把选中的这段放进剪贴板。 |
| 标记 / 取消标记 | 给这段加上或去掉颜色。点标记后，上方浮出红、蓝、黄；加号打开调色板。自己选的颜色会留下，一共最多 5 种。颜色只留在原文上，不会自动进笔记。 |
| 划线 / 取消划线 | 给这段加金色下划线，或把下划线去掉。下划线只留在原文上，不会自动进笔记。 |
| 加入笔记 / 移出笔记 | 把选中的整段收进「学习」。原文出现浅灰色虚线下划线。再选中同一段，可以移出。 |
| 提问 / 追问 | 就这段发问。已经问过的，接着问同一条。 |

思考过程不会出现这张卡片。

### 笔记

「加入笔记」收进的整段，以及提问和追问，都进「学习」页。标记和划线不会自动出现在这里。每一条都能改摘录、问题和批注，也能删除。摘录会记下原文里的加粗、斜体和代码。上面是预览，落在这段里的标记颜色和金色划线也会画在预览上，下面一格是 Markdown，改完会保存。复制选区和「复制笔记」带上的也是这份 Markdown。同一大段里如果拆成了好几张，改摘录就能收成你想留的那一张，多余的删掉。

「笔记 · 数量」旁边可以按类别筛选，类别可以自己添加。每条笔记选一个类别，没选的是未分类。勾选之后可以全选当前筛出来的笔记，一起改类别或删除。复制笔记时带上类别，并且只复制当前筛出来的这些。

笔记写在本机的 `~/.dsh/study-notes/`（Windows 上是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\study-notes\`），按工作区分开，里面是 `index.json` 和对应的 Markdown。不写进你正在打开的项目仓库。

再选中同一段，按钮变成「取消标记」「取消划线」或「移出笔记」。取消标记和取消划线只去掉原文上的颜色或金色下划线。移出笔记会从「学习」里拿走整段，并去掉虚线下划线。选区跟已有标注重叠，或去掉空白后是同一句，也算这一条。别处还有一句完全相同的文字时，会一起取消。

### 就一句话提问

选「提问」，写上例如「这段是什么」，也可以先选模型。

这句话不会被划线。问题和摘录记在「学习」里。这句话还在对话里时，句末出现一个小引用符号：

- 合上时，只有这个符号。
- 点开后，是贴在这句话旁边的便利贴，里面是你的问题和这条进程最新的一条回复。
- 回复还没写完时，便利贴上是「正在回答…」。
- 按 Esc，或点「合上」，便利贴收起。

提问不会把主对话换成另一页。回答写在侧栏里，不写到主对话下面。旁边的「任务管理」仍能看见这条进程。

### 一条进程可以一直问下去

一条笔记对应一条进程。不同的句子是并排的几条，互不套娃。

这条进程开在右侧栏，输入方式和主对话一样，新的一轮往下接在同一页。下面三种问法都进这一条，不会再套出「主进程 → 子进程 → 子进程」：

- 在侧栏里直接打字。
- 在主对话里对同一句再点「追问」。
- 在已经打开的这条进程里再选一段追问。

它记得自己前面的回答。更早那种问完即止、不能接着写的进程，需要回到主对话重新提问。

### 模型

三处可以选模型：选中文字后浮出的提问卡、「学习」页上的提问或追问、以及已经打开的子进程输入框上方。

- 「跟随当前对话」：新开的这条用你当前对话的模型。
- 「沿用当前模型」：这次追问不换。
- 点名一个模型：新进程从这一轮就用它；已经打开的进程，从下一条回复起用它。正在写的那一条不会中途换掉。

列表里先是 DeepSeek V4 Pro 和 DeepSeek Flash，然后是桌面配置 `profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` 里写明的模型。没有的模型会提示「没有这个模型」。子进程页面上，软件自带的模型菜单不会出现，所以换模型用的是输入框上方这一处。

### 安装

从 npm 安装当前发布的版本。profile 名一般是 `desktop`。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-marginalia
```

要固定版本，把包名写成 `dsh-marginalia@0.1.3`。装好或更新后，把 DeepSeek Harness 完全退出，包括托盘图标，再打开。只关窗口不够。

也可以从本机目录安装。把路径换成这套插件所在的目录：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./path/to/dsh-marginalia
```

查看 npm 上的版本：

```bash
npm view dsh-marginalia version
```

包页面是 https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-marginalia 。

要求 Node.js 20 或更高，DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3`。这份 0.1.3 是按桌面版 `0.2.1-rc.2` 写的。

不要把本插件再写进 profile 自己的 `cordis.patch.yml`。命令行看到 `package.json` 里的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 后，会自己把 `cordis.patch.yml` 接上。写两遍会挂两次。

### 边界

- 一次标注最多 4000 字。一条对话最多 400 条。一条批注、一个问题最多 2000 字。
- 便利贴里的回复最多显示 20000 字。
- 还没有自动整理，也没有导出 PDF。
- 进程没在运行时，换模型会提示「这条进程没有在运行，换不了模型。」

本地检查：

```bash
node --test lib/model.test.js lib/quote.test.js
```

### 发布到 npm

同一版本只能发布一次。先改版本号，再发布。`--no-git-tag-version` 只改 `package.json`，不会自己做 Git 提交，因此不需要先设置 Git 作者。

```bash
npm login
npm whoami
npm version patch --no-git-tag-version
npm publish --access public
```

`npm login` 在 npm 11 里会打开网页确认。成功时 `npm whoami` 显示用户名，`npm publish` 的最后一行是 `+ dsh-marginalia@x.y.z`。

如果发布返回 403，并写着需要 two-factor authentication 或 granular access token with bypass 2fa，网页登录留下的令牌不能用来发版。到 https://www.npmjs.com/settings/~/tokens 新建 Granular Access Token，权限选 Read and write，范围选 All packages，并勾选 Bypass two-factor authentication。然后在自己的终端执行 `npm config set //registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken`，后面接那枚新令牌，再重新 `npm publish --access public`。不要把令牌或验证码写进仓库、对话或截图。发完可以删掉这枚令牌。

## English

dsh-marginalia is a desktop plugin for DeepSeek Harness. On the conversation page, a tab named 学习 sits beside 对话. A blank new chat hides that tab row.

Stay in the conversation and select part of an assistant reply, or part of a message you sent. A white card appears at the upper right of the caret. A right-click opens the same card.

| Button | What it does |
|---|---|
| 复制 | Copy the selection. |
| 标记 / 取消标记 | Color the span, or clear that mark. After 标记, a row floats above with red, blue, and yellow. + opens a palette. Chosen colors are kept, and there can be at most five. The color stays on the message and does not become a note by itself. |
| 划线 / 取消划线 | Underline the span in gold, or clear that underline. The underline stays on the message and does not become a note by itself. |
| 加入笔记 / 移出笔记 | Add the whole selection to 学习. The message gets a light gray dashed underline. Select that same passage again to remove the note. |
| 提问 / 追问 | Ask about this span. If you already asked, continue that same side conversation. |

The reasoning trace does not open this card.

### Notes

Passages added with 加入笔记, plus questions and follow-ups, are listed on the 学习 page. A color mark or a gold underline does not appear there on its own. Each row can edit the excerpt, the question, and the comment, and each row can be deleted. The excerpt keeps bold, italics, and code from the original message. The card shows a preview, including mark colors and gold underlines that fall inside that passage, and the box under it is the Markdown you can change and save. Copying a selection, and 复制笔记, both carry that Markdown. If one passage was split into several notes, edit the excerpt so the one you want covers it, then delete the extras.

Beside the note count, the list can be filtered by category, and categories can be added freely. Each note can be given one; a note without one stays uncategorized. Checked notes can be selected together, then assigned a category or deleted. 复制笔记 includes the category and copies only the notes the filter is showing.

Notes are stored on this machine under `~/.dsh/study-notes/` (`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\study-notes\` on Windows), grouped by workspace, as `index.json` plus a Markdown file. They are not written into the project you have open.

Select the same span again and the button becomes 取消标记, 取消划线, or 移出笔记. Clearing a color or a gold underline leaves the notes list unchanged. 移出笔记 removes that passage from 学习 and clears the dashed underline. An overlapping selection, or the same words with different line breaks, counts as that mark. The same quote elsewhere is removed with it.

### Ask about one sentence

Choose 提问 and type something like “这段是什么”. You can pick a model first.

The sentence is not underlined. The question and the excerpt are saved on the 学习 page. While that sentence is still in the conversation, a small citation mark sits at the end:

- Collapsed, only that mark is visible.
- Expanded, a sticky note beside the sentence shows your question and the latest reply.
- Until the reply is finished, the note says 正在回答….
- Esc, or 合上, closes it.

The question does not replace the main conversation. The reply is written in the side column, not under the main conversation. The side task list still shows this child.

### One child keeps going

One note is one side conversation. Different sentences are parallel conversations. They do not nest inside each other.

The child opens in the right column. You type there the same way as in the main conversation, and the next turn extends downward on that page. These three actions all continue that same child:

- Type in the side column.
- Choose 追问 on the same sentence in the main conversation.
- Select text inside the open child and ask again.

The child keeps its own earlier answers. An older one-shot child cannot be continued. Ask again from the main conversation.

### Models

You can choose a model in three places: the card that appears after a selection, the ask form on the 学习 page, and the control labeled 模型 above the input of an open child.

- 跟随当前对话 starts the new child with the model of the conversation you asked from.
- 沿用当前模型 leaves the current model in place for this follow-up.
- A named model is used from the first turn of a new child, or from the next reply of a child that is already open. A reply that is already being written is left as it is.

The list starts with DeepSeek V4 Pro and DeepSeek Flash, then the models declared in `profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`. An unknown model is

plugins.description: 给 DSH Web 侧栏腾点地方。 Too many DSH plugins, too little room.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-toomuch-plugins **Makes room in the DSH Web sidebar.** · *Too many plugins, too little room.* [![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/rivenshanghai/dsh-toomuch-plugins)](https://github.com/rivenshanghai/dsh-toomuch-plugins/blob/main/LICENSE) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-toomuch-plugins)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-toomuch-plugins) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/rivenshanghai/dsh-toomuch-plugins) [![topic](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-8A2BE2)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- A small plugin set that gives the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) Web sidebar some breathing room. It ships one plugin today: | Plugin | What it does | | --- | --- | | Sidebar panel collapse | Collapses the "global panels" column above the workspace into one toggle in the sidebar footer | ## Why The DSH Web sidebar stacks, from top to bottom: brand row → new session → **global panel entries** → workspace → settings. Every plugin that adds a sidebar entry adds a row to that column: plugins, plugin market, schedules, MCP studio, context, skill manager, system monitor… Seven rows are roughly 280px, which squeezes the workspace region down to a few sessions. This plugin does exactly one thing: **collapse that column of global panel entries**, and bring it back when you need it. ## Highlights - **Collapsed by default** — the workspace gets ~280px back as soon as the plugin is installed. - **One toggle** in the sidebar footer, right above "settings". - **Remembered** in `localStorage`; survives reloads and restarts. - **Nothing else is touched** — no panel, no workspace, no host behaviour; only the display of the list element the sidebar already renders. - **Themed** with `--dsw-alias-*` tokens only, so it follows the DSH theme. - **Rail-friendly** — in the narrow 56px rail the toggle becomes a round icon button. ## Install The plugin is a repository-root package: it declares the `dsh.bundle` manifest, so DSH can install it straight from npm or GitHub. ```sh # from npm (prebuilt — no build approval step) dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-toomuch-plugins # from GitHub dsh plugin --profile web add github:rivenshanghai/dsh-toomuch-plugins # or from a local clone git clone https://github.com/rivenshanghai/dsh-toomuch-plugins.git dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-toomuch-plugins ``` `dsh plugin` forwards to `pnpm` inside the profile. After the install, **enable the plugin** in DSH's plugin settings (it is written into the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`), then refresh the page. From the plugin market, once listed: open **Settings → Plugin Market** in DSH and search for `dsh-toomuch-plugins`. **Verify:** the sidebar footer gains a "Collapse global panels / Expand global panels" row above "settings", and the global panel column is gone. Requirements: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) with a `web` profile; Node.js ≥ 20. ## How it works `src/client.js` does three things: 1. registers a toggle into the sidebar footer slot `sidebar.footer.action` (the row next to "settings"); 2. walks up from its own root node to find the sidebar root's direct `
` child — the global panel list — and toggles its `display`; 3. remembers the choice in `localStorage`. The basis is DSH's own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar`: `nav.panelList` is a direct child of the sidebar root, so walking up from the footer button always reaches it. Styling uses only `--dsw-alias-*` theme variables, and the stylesheet rides inside the component, so unmounting removes it. No DSH internal package is imported, and no DSH file is modified. The full contract is written down in [docs/design.md](docs/design.md). ## Repository layout ``` . ├── package.json plugin manifest: dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client ├── cordis.patch.yml inserts the loader row into the profile ├── src/ │ ├── index.js Host half (no host capabilities needed; apply is empty) │ └── client.js Client half: footer toggle + collapse/expand logic ├── locale/{en,zh}.json title and description in the plugin list ├── docs/ design notes, market submission, pre-submit checklist ├── icon.svg icon ├── CHANGELOG.md └── LICENSE ``` ## Known limits - It collapses the **global panel entries** column only. The brand row, new session and settings are left alone — the brand row's "collapse sidebar" button is the only entry point on Linux / Windows, so hiding it would lose a feature. - With no global panels installed, the sidebar never renders that `
` and the toggle is a harmless no-op. - Verified on DSH Web (Linux) only. ## Plugin market DSH plugins are listed in the [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) catalog, which aggregates the repositories carrying the **`dsh-plugin`** GitHub topic. Add that topic to this repository, then open a one-file pull request against that catalog: the entry file is `data/plugins/__.yml`, with a `category`, a one-line `description.en` and an optional `description.zh` (the catalog's contributing guide has the exact rules). ## Related plugins - [dsh-sidebar-quiet](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-sidebar-quiet) — folds the sidebar **footer** rows (balance / import / memory / sign out) into one line - [dsh-sidebar-buttons](https://github.com/lywusichen/dsh-sidebar-buttons) — manage sidebar footer buttons: drag to reorder, show / fold into More / hide - [dsh-sidebar-pins](https://github.com/AndreyTepaykin/dsh-sidebar-pins) — a collapsible pinned-sessions block above the settings row - [dsh-sidebar-drawer](https://github.com/1dustycy/dsh-sidebar-drawer) — an edge-hover drawer that expands the sidebar - [dsh-plugin-sidebar-visibility](https://github.com/Robert-Wang-08/dsh-plugin-sidebar-visibility) — hide / collapse at the workspace level ## Contributing Bug reports and pull requests are welcome. Please include your DSH version, the browser, and whether the toggle appeared in the sidebar footer. Keep the change focused: this plugin does one thing, and the DOM contract it relies on is documented in [docs/design.md](docs/design.md). ## License MIT © [rivenshanghai](https://github.com/rivenshanghai) — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: OpenCode / OpenCode Go provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
plugins.readme_text:
# 📦 @goodandready/dsh-opencode-provider

OpenCode Console & OpenCode Go LLM Provider for DeepSeek Harness

⭐ If you like this plugin, please star it on GitHub — it shows me that the plugin is useful to you and motivates me to keep developing it.

🐛 If you find a bug or would like to request a feature, open a GitHub issue in any language — I will review your proposal and implement useful suggestions in a future plugin version.
--- OpenCode / OpenCode Go provider plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/) (dsh). It registers two native LLM routes: | Route | Product | Base | |---|---|---| | `opencode-direct` | OpenCode Console / Zen (pay-as-you-go) | `https://opencode.ai/inference` | | `opencode-go-direct` | OpenCode Go / Go Plus subscription | `https://opencode.ai/inference/go` | Requests resolve the key per call, so a changed credential reaches the next request without a restart. The ids use the `-direct` suffix because the built-in `llm-pi-ai` catalog already owns `opencode` and `opencode-go`. Reusing those ids makes the core registry reject the duplicate (`DUPLICATE_DIRECTORY`) and drop the built-in catalog, which hides the other providers and disables the add button. Existing sessions recorded under the old ids stay on the built-in routes; select **OpenCode (plugin)** or **OpenCode Go (plugin)** for this plugin's accounts, quotas, fallback and telemetry. ## Architecture ```mermaid graph LR subgraph DSH["DeepSeek Harness Core"] Agent["DSH Agent / Chat"] Creds["Credentials / auth.json"] end subgraph Plugin["dsh-opencode-provider"] Router{"Route Selector"} Pool["Multi-Account Pool
(Auto-Rotation & Cooldowns)"] Heatmap["Heatmap & Quota Telemetry
(5h / Week / Month)"] subgraph Transports["4 Wire Transports"] T1["OpenAI Chat"] T2["Anthropic Messages
(Thinking Signatures)"] T3["OpenAI Responses"] T4["Google GenAI
(thoughtSignature Replay)"] end end subgraph OpenCode["OpenCode Gateway"] Console["opencode-direct (Console / Zen)"] Go["opencode-go-direct (Go / Go Plus)"] end Agent --> Router Creds -.-> Pool Router -->|opencode-direct| Pool Router -->|opencode-go-direct| Pool Pool --> Heatmap Pool --> Transports T1 & T2 & T3 & T4 --> Console & Go ``` ## What works - **Four wire transports**, chosen per model: - OpenAI Chat Completions (DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiMo, LongCat, Hy3, Step, …). - Anthropic Messages (Claude Haiku, MiniMax, Qwen). - OpenAI Responses (GPT, Grok, Muse). - Google Generative AI (Gemini). - **Text, reasoning, streamed tool calls, usage, finish reasons.** - **Images** through the durable attachment service, rendered natively per transport; **file attachments** are projected to DSH's deterministic handle text (the harness supplies the read-only execution path), never inline bytes. - **Tool-result images** are inlined by Anthropic, OpenAI Responses and Google; OpenAI Chat keeps the text placeholder because its tool message has no image part. - **Replay of provider metadata** where the endpoint requires it: - Anthropic thinking signatures. - Gemini `thoughtSignature` on historical function calls. - **Multi-account rotation** before a stream starts: 401/403/429 and quota/usage-limit bodies (400/402/403/429). An invalid key cools down for 24h, a quota rejection for 10 minutes or `Retry-After`, a rate limit for 60s or `Retry-After`. A request already streaming is never replayed on another account; the next request uses the next usable key. - **Per-account quotas**: each account row shows its own 5-hour / weekly / monthly usage, the active account drives the sidebar and quota panel, and the panel lists every account side by side. - **Per-account runway**: estimates time to exhaustion from the average burn rate of each window and marks the first window projected to run out before its reset; approximate because the API exposes only the current percentage and reset time. - **Model → account rules**: first matching glob pins a preferred account for that model; the other accounts remain fallbacks if it fails or is cooling. - **Request heatmap** in the quota panel: a Monday-first weekday × hour grid in local time, plus a 24-hour aggregate strip underneath. Selectors switch between all requests, any single model, and any single account. A per-account table shows requests, errors and average latency/TTFT. The adapter appends `{at, provider, model, purpose?, account, reason, ok, latencyMs, ttftMs?, error?}` to `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-opencode/requests.jsonl`; no prompt, response or key is stored. Auxiliary `session-title`/`compaction` calls are excluded from the heatmap and exact duplicate records collapse. The log compacts at 2 MB to the newest 5000 lines. Collection starts with this build — the projection cache only has `lastPromptAt`, not per-request timestamps. - **Stable `x-opencode-session`** derived from the durable session id, so retries and every turn of a conversation reuse the same routing key. - **Live catalog** from `/v1/models` with a generated `models.dev` fallback. - **Per-model subscription limits** from the OpenCode Go pricing table: monthly dollar allowance plus estimated requests for the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows, for both Go and Go Plus. Shown in the model picker and the settings page; estimates only — the gateway remains the authority. - **`/opencode` command** for status, usage, accounts, models, rules, and `test [model]`. - **TUI settings section** for the terminal profile (`/settings → OpenCode`) with the key, endpoints, allowlist, active account, fallback model, sticky routing and timeouts. - **Quota fallback**: choose a free model in Settings → OpenCode; a Go quota rejection retries once through Console/Zen. - **Sticky account**: the last successful account is preferred for the same conversation and survives restarts via a local `sticky.json` (hashed session ids and key fingerprints only); explicit model rules and pinned accounts win. - **Routing trace** in the quota panel and per-account heatmap filter. - **One-click plugin update** in Settings → OpenCode: current/latest version, an update badge, and an **Update now** button that installs the exact npm version through the DSH CLI and asks for a restart. The host endpoint is `GET/POST /dsh-opencode/update`. - **Plan-aware Go picker**: hides models outside the Go table unless turned off; descriptions carry `Go`, `Console` or `FREE`. - **Request-wide image budget** (newest images win, oldest become an omitted placeholder) and **object-root tool-schema normalization** for MCP/third-party tools. - **Usage analytics dashboard** in the quota panel: KPI cards (requests, tokens, success, input/output, reasoning, cache, TTFT, latency, errors), a 7/30/90 selector, and Models / Days / Sessions tables. Success and error cards show `—`: the local projection does not expose failed attempts or reasoning tokens. - **Usage by model** from the local session projection cache: sessions and tokens per OpenCode model. Only numeric metadata is read; titles and message content stay local. - **Browser UI**: - **Settings → OpenCode**: key status, paste/import/clear, quota bars, accounts, model allowlist, per-model transport overrides, connection settings. -

plugins.description: Zero-token scheduled script runner for DeepSeek Harness (dsh-plugin): cron in the Host, no model calls, wake-on-change
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-noagent-schedule

**Run shell scripts on a schedule inside DeepSeek Harness — with no model call and no token cost.**

Every scheduling plugin in the DSH ecosystem delivers a message to a session or starts a new one,
so a cron tick always means a model wake-up. This plugin takes the other path: the Host runs the
command itself, the way `systemd` or `launchd` would. The model is only involved when you actually
want it to be — see [wake on change](#wake-on-change).

[简体中文](README.zh.md)

## What it gives you

| | |
|---|---|
| **Zero token** | A tick that runs a script costs nothing. The plugin never touches the LLM services. |
| **Cron or interval** | Five-field Vixie cron (`*/15 9-17 * * 1-5`, `sun..sat`, `jan..dec`) or `everySeconds`. |
| **Explicit time zones** | IANA zones per job, so the schedule means what it says regardless of where the Host runs. |
| **Logs you can read** | One file per run with argv, exit code, stdout and stderr; a `runs.jsonl` ledger beside it. |
| **Overlap protection** | A job whose previous run is still going is skipped, not stacked. |
| **Timeout** | Oversized jobs are terminated at `timeoutSeconds`. |
| **Qinglong-style task page** (open it from the sidebar; not duplicated in Settings) | Overview cards, search and status filter, one row per job with a status dot, a human-readable schedule ("daily 18:30" instead of `30 18 * * *`), last and next run, a strip of the last 8 results, and a log drawer. |
| **Edit from the page** | Enable or disable a job, change its cron or interval, timeout, name or command, and delete it. Every write is validated, backed up, and re-parsed before it lands, so `jobs.json` can never be left unloadable. |
| **Agent tools** | `noagent_status`, `noagent_run`, `noagent_log`, `noagent_update` — the same operations the UI uses. |
| **Wake on change** | Turn a polling script into an event source: the model is woken only when its output changes. |

## Install

### From the plugin market (Discover)

Open **Plugins > Discover > Manage index sources** and add:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/monkey-sking/dsh-noagent-schedule/main/index.json
```

The bundle then appears in the Discover list with its description and icon, and installs like any other entry. (The Discover tab needs the experimental plugin-market bundle enabled.)

### From a checkout

```
git clone https://github.com/monkey-sking/dsh-noagent-schedule.git
plugin_manager({ action: "install_bundle", target: "<cloned directory>" })
```

Or point `target` at a checkout of this repository.

Nothing is scheduled until you write a job file.

## Where things live

| | Default | Configure |
|---|---|---|
| Job list | `~/.dsh/noagent/jobs.json` | `jobsFile` |
| State and logs | `~/.dsh/noagent/state/` | `stateDir` |

The job file is re-read every 10 seconds, so adding, editing or disabling a job needs no restart.

```
state/
├── state.json              # per job: last start, exit code, duration, fingerprint
├── runs.jsonl              # one line per run
└── runs/<job-id>/<ts>.log  # full stdout/stderr of that run
```

## Jobs

```json
{
  "jobs": [
    {
      "id": "nightly-backup",
      "name": "Nightly backup",
      "enabled": true,
      "cron": "0 3 * * *",
      "timeZone": "Asia/Shanghai",
      "cwd": "/srv/app",
      "command": "bash scripts/backup.sh",
      "timeoutSeconds": 600
    }
  ]
}
```

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | Unique, also the log directory name. Required. |
| `cron` | Five fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week. Supports `*/n`, `a-b`, `a-b/n`, lists, `sun..sat`, `jan..dec`. |
| `everySeconds` | Fixed interval, minimum 30. Use instead of `cron`. |
| `timeZone` | IANA zone. Defaults to the plugin's `defaultTimeZone`. |
| `cwd` | Working directory. Defaults to the user's home. |
| `command` | Run through `/bin/bash -lc`. Alternatively use `argv` for an exact process. |
| `argv` | Array form; no shell involved. |
| `env` | Extra environment variables, merged over the inherited environment. |
| `timeoutSeconds` | Terminate after this long. Default 300. |
| `enabled` | `false` keeps the job in the file but does not schedule it. |
| `wakeOnChange` | See below. |

### Why `bash -lc`

A GUI-launched Host inherits a minimal `PATH` — often just `/usr/bin:/bin`. A login shell picks up
the user's profile, so `git`, `node`, `python3` and friends resolve the way they do in a terminal.
Homebrew's standard prefixes are prepended as a fallback.

If you would rather not depend on shell startup files, use `argv` with absolute paths.

## Wake on change

A polling script usually answers one question: *did anything change?* Running it on a timer is
free; waking a model to ask the same question every few minutes is not.

`wakeOnChange` separates the two:

```json
{
  "id": "inbox-watch",
  "everySeconds": 120,
  "command": "bash scripts/probe-inbox.sh",
  "wakeOnChange": {
    "sessionId": "session-…",
    "title": "New mail",
    "prompt": "The probe found something new:\n\n{{output}}\n\nHandle it per the usual routine; reply [SILENT] if nothing needs doing.",
    "ignoreLines": ["^ts=", "progress: \\d+%"]
  }
}
```

How it behaves:

- The probe runs every 120 seconds. **No change means no model call at all.**
- Output is normalised (lines matching `ignoreLines` are dropped), then fingerprinted.
- A changed fingerprint schedules a one-shot delivery to `sessionId` about a second later, carrying
  the probe output through `{{output}}`.
- The first run only records a baseline, so installing the plugin does not immediately wake anyone.
  Set `notifyOnFirstRun: true` to opt in.
- A non-zero exit is never treated as "something changed" — failures show up in the log and the
  status, not as false wakes.
- Every wake is a one-shot scheduled delivery, and one-shot rows stay in the Host's task table
  after delivery. The plugin deletes each wake row once it has been delivered (the previous row is
  removed before the next wake, delivered rows are swept every 30 seconds, and leftovers from an
  earlier version are cleaned on the first tick), so "automation tasks" keeps listing only the real
  recurring jobs instead of a wall of identical one-shot entries.
- Empty output means nothing to report.
- `onlyOnNew` can be narrowed with `keyPattern`: only the matched part of each line identifies an
  entry, so a conversation whose last message changes (including our own reply) is not "new"; only a
  genuinely new conversation wakes the session. Lines unmatched by the pattern fall back to the
  whole line.

Placeholders in `prompt` and `title`: `{{job}}` (name), `{{id}}` (id), `{{output}}` (truncated to
4000 characters).

The target session receives an ordinary scheduled message, so anything that already works with a
scheduled delivery works here.

## UI

- **Settings → No-Agent Schedule** — one page listing every job.
- **Sidebar → clock icon** — the same list as a panel.

Both show the schedule, time zone, command, last run (time, exit code, duration), a *Run now*
button and a *Show last log* toggle. The panel refreshes every five seconds while open.

## Agent tools

| Tool | Does |
|---|---|
| `noagent_status` | List jobs with their last run. Pass `id` for one job. |
| `noagent_run` | Run one job immediately, outside its schedule. |
| `noagent_log` | Read the tail of a job's most recent log. |

The UI and the tools call the same Host implementation.

## Limits

- **Runs only while DSH is running.** A tick missed because the Host was closed is not caught up on
  restart. For a watchdog that must survive the app being closed, use `launchd`, `systemd` or
  `cron` instead — that is what they are for.
- **Not a sandbox.** Jobs run with the Host's own permissions. Treat the job file as executable
  configuration.
- **macOS may still refuse access.** A Host process inherits the app's TCC grants; a job touching a
  protected location can fail where a terminal would succeed, and vice versa. Read the log rather
  than assuming.

## Related

- [agent-cron-kit](https://github.com/monkey-sking/agent-cron-kit) — the scripts this scheduler was
  built to run: a stdout→Feishu/Telegram delivery bridge, git autopush and dirty-repo wa

plugins.description: Windows 桌面通知：需要你确认时、你作出回答后、任务结束时各弹一条系统通知（DSH 插件）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-windows-notify

给 DSH 加一条 Windows 系统通知：**需要你确认**、**你已经回答**、**任务结束**的时候各弹一条，切到别的窗口也不会漏。

只装宿主端（Host-only），没有前端界面，不联网，不带依赖。仅支持 Windows。

## 安装

### 从 npm（推荐）

在 DSH 会话里让 agent 用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle` 安装包名 `dsh-windows-notify`，它会从 npm 装进当前 profile 并写好配置行：

```powershell
npm install dsh-windows-notify   # 也可以自己装进 profile 目录，再用 install_bundle 指向包名启用
```

### 从源码

1. 把仓库放到本机任意目录：

   ```powershell
   git clone https://github.com/3493750852/dsh-windows-notify.git
   ```

2. 让 agent 用 `install_bundle` 安装这个目录的绝对路径。

3. 验证：随便发一条消息，本轮结束时应该收到「任务完成」通知；点它应该回到 DSH 窗口。

## 三个触发点分别是什么

| 你看到的通知 | 触发时机 | 事件来源 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 需要你确认 | 有工具在申请授权，真的开始等你点 | `approval/request` |
| 需要你回答 | 模型问了 `ask_user_question`，等你选 | `user-questions/request` |
| 你已回答 | 你点了允许/拒绝，或选完了选项 | 上面两个请求返回时 |
| 任务完成 / 任务出错 | 本轮结束，且这一轮超过 `taskEndMinSeconds` | `session/event` 的 `turn/end` + `agent/error` |

几条避免打扰的规则：

- **自动应答不提醒**：请求在 `interactionDelayMs`（默认 1.2 秒）内就被宿主自动处理（比如策略是 `never` 直接拒绝），说明根本没人被问到，不弹通知。
- **秒回不提醒**：一轮任务短于 `taskEndMinSeconds`（默认 8 秒）就不提示任务结束。
- **子智能体不提醒**：子会话自己的回合不弹，避免一次任务刷出一串通知。
- **等待回答时不当作任务结束**：有请求挂着的时候，即使这一轮结束了也不弹「任务完成」。
- **装插件时正在进行的那一轮**：结束时照样提示，只是没有「用时」（插件没看到这一轮的开始）。

## 通知长什么样

Windows 10/11 上它是一条标准通知（托盘气泡，系统会渲染进通知中心），带 **DSH 自己的图标**、标题、正文和系统提示音：

- 需要你确认：`需要你确认` / `Bash：执行命令 npm install`
- 需要你回答：`需要你回答` / `你希望用哪种方案？`
- 你已回答：`你已回答` / `Bash → 允许`
- 任务完成：`任务完成` / `帮我做一个 dsh 插件 · 用时 2 分 13 秒`
- 任务出错：`任务出错` / `... · <错误信息>`

图标不是内置的通用图标，而是**从正在运行的 DSH 应用上取的**（`DeepSeek Harness.exe` 自己带的图标），所以跟任务栏里那个是同一个。

## 点一下通知

点通知会把 **DSH 窗口叫到前台**（最小化了也会还原）。

实现上不是硬抢焦点：桌面壳持有单实例锁，再启动一次应用就会走到它自己的「聚焦或重建主窗口」那条路，所以用的是应用认可的入口，不会被 Windows 的前台锁拦掉。

- 通知在屏幕上（以及进通知中心后的约 8 秒内）点它有效 —— 之后负责接点击的进程已经退出，点了不会有反应。
- 如果你用的是浏览器里的 Web GUI 而没有桌面应用，会退化成用浏览器打开那个 GUI 地址。
- 想换成「一律用浏览器打开」或「点了只关掉」，改 `clickAction` 为 `url` / `none`。

> DSH 的 Web UI 没有「会话级 URL」（前端不读地址栏），所以点击只能把窗口叫到前台，不能直接跳到某个后台会话；通知正文里带了会话标题，方便你对上号。

## 开关

全部开关都在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里那一行的 `config` 下（也可以在 DSH 的配置文件里改同样的键），改完重启 DSH 生效：

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关 |
| `confirm` | `true` | 需要你确认 / 回答时提示 |
| `answered` | `true` | 你回答之后提示 |
| `taskEnd` | `true` | 任务结束时提示 |
| `taskError` | `true` | 报错结束时也提示（文案变「任务出错」） |
| `sound` | `true` | 播放系统提示音 |
| `language` | `zh` | 通知文案语言，`zh` 或 `en` |
| `showSessionTitle` | `true` | 任务结束通知里带会话标题 |
| `taskEndMinSeconds` | `8` | 短于这个秒数的任务不提示结束 |
| `interactionDelayMs` | `1200` | 请求挂起超过这个毫秒数才算「真的在等你」 |
| `hideWhenSubagent` | `true` | 子智能体结束不提示 |
| `powershellPath` | `powershell.exe` | 想用 PowerShell 7 可以填 `pwsh.exe` |
| `maxConcurrent` | `3` | 同时最多几条通知进程 |
| `coalesceMs` | `700` | 同类通知的去重窗口 |
| `clickAction` | `focus` | 点通知时：`focus` 叫回 DSH 窗口 / `url` 用浏览器打开 / `none` 只关掉 |
| `appProcessName` | `DeepSeek Harness` | 桌面进程名，用来取它自己的图标、点击时叫回窗口 |
| `dwellSeconds` | `8` | 通知可点击（托盘图标存在）的秒数 |
| `selfTest` | `false` | 改成 `true` 重载插件，会立刻弹一条自检通知（验证安装用） |
| `debug` | `false` | 把每次通知的判定过程写进 `%TEMP%\dsh-windows-notify.log` |

## 收不到通知时

0. **先做自检**：把 `selfTest` 改成 `true` 重载插件（或重启 DSH）。能弹出「通知自检：插件已加载」说明插件和系统通知都正常，问题在触发条件；弹不出来就再打开 `debug`，看 `%TEMP%\dsh-windows-notify.log` 里 `shim exit ... after=...ms` 这一行 —— 正常应该是几千毫秒，如果只有几十毫秒，说明 PowerShell 没能真正跑起来。
1. **Windows 通知总开关**：设置 → 系统 → 通知，确认「通知」是开的。
2. **专注助手 / 勿扰**：开着的时候通知会进通知中心但不弹横幅，不会响。
3. **通知中心里有没有**：按 `Win + N` 看历史。有记录但没弹出来，基本就是专注助手。
4. **手动测一次**（在插件目录里，会立刻弹一条测试通知；点它应该把 DSH 叫到前台）：

   ```powershell
   $json = '{"title":"测试通知","body":"点我应该会回到 DSH 窗口","kind":"done","sound":true,"onClick":"focus","appProcessName":"DeepSeek Harness","dwellMs":20000}'
   $b64 = [Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($json))
   powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\notify.ps1 -PayloadBase64 $b64
   ```

   退出码 `0` 表示通知已正常走完；`2` 是载荷解析失败；`3` 是系统拒绝创建通知。

## 实现说明

- 通知走一个独立的、隐藏窗口的 PowerShell 进程（`notify.ps1`）：显示托盘气泡、跑一个短消息循环接点击，最多 `dwellSeconds` 秒后自行退出；宿主进程不阻塞、不等待。
- 文案以 **base64 编码的 UTF-8 JSON** 传给 PowerShell，不经过命令行转义，中文不会被代码页破坏。
- 图标和点击目标都在脚本里从**运行中的应用**解析（`Get-Process 'DeepSeek Harness'` → 它的路径与图标），不写死安装路径。
- 三个观察点都是普通 waterfall 事件监听：只 `await next()` 并把结果原样返回，不改变任何决策。

plugins.description: Permanently delete sessions from the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, including live sessions and caches.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-delete

为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的侧栏会话菜单增加**永久删除**操作，支持中文和英文。

在会话行的操作菜单中选择 **删除会话**，核对名称后点击 **永久删除**。正在执行任务的会话会被拒绝删除，插件不会强制停止任务。

> 删除后无法恢复。当前正式版本为 **1.1.0**，仅支持 DSH **0.2.1-rc.2**。下载与更新说明见 [v1.1.0 Release](https://github.com/huy8000/dsh-session-delete/releases/tag/v1.1.0)。

## 兼容性

| 会话状态 | 原版 DSH | 安装本仓库生命周期补丁的 DSH |
|---|---|---|
| 未加载的空闲历史会话 | 可以删除 | 可以删除 |
| 已打开或已恢复的空闲会话 | 拒绝删除 | 标准 Agent 会话安全关闭后删除 |
| 任务执行中、维护中或有待处理输入 | 拒绝删除 | 拒绝删除 |

**只安装插件不会给 DSH 增加关闭会话的能力。** 要删除已加载的空闲会话，需要额外应用 [DSH 生命周期补丁](patches/README.md)。补丁针对固定版本源码，尚未合入上游；不支持关闭的第三方 Agent 会明确拒绝删除。

所有删除都要求单个 DSH Host 独占会话、缓存和工作区存储。多个 Desktop、Web 或 CLI 实例共用一套存储不受支持。

## 安装

在 DSH 的插件页面添加本地仓库路径，或使用 Git 地址：

```text
git+https://github.com/huy8000/dsh-session-delete.git
```

启用插件后，在对应 Profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中添加：

```yaml
- id: dsh-session-delete
  config:
    singleHost: true
```

Desktop 默认配置位于 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`；设置了 `DSH_HOME` 时使用对应目录。完成后重启 DSH Host；Desktop 用户可退出并重新打开应用。

`singleHost` 默认关闭，关闭时插件不会执行删除。只有确认存储由一个 Host 独占后才应启用；这是使用者的声明，不会自动检测其他进程，也不提供跨进程保护。

## 使用

1. 打开侧栏会话行的操作菜单，选择 **删除会话**。
2. 在确认框中核对会话名称和不可恢复提示。
3. 点击 **永久删除**。成功后，会话从列表移除；删除当前查看的会话时，页面回到新会话入口。

取消、Escape 或点击遮罩可以关闭尚未执行中的确认框。删除进行中会禁用重复提交和关闭操作。失败时保留确认框，分开显示失败原因及必要的数据状态。

## 删除范围

插件会清理目标会话的：

- 已识别的 JSONL 持久化日志。
- 当前会话投影缓存。
- Workspace 关联、置顶和归档记录。

用于上游写锁的 `session.lock` 和空目录会保留。工作区中的项目文件、导出副本、外部备份、附件及第三方插件数据不在清理范围内。

删除不是跨文件事务。路径不明、符号链接、异常存储结构、写入占用或无法确认的生命周期状态都会导致拒绝。共享存储和不遵守 DSH 生命周期的第三方后台写入不在支持范围内。

## 删除失败时

| 提示或情况 | 处理方式 |
|---|---|
| 会话正在运行 | 等待任务结束后重试；已归档也不代表没有活动任务 |
| 当前 DSH 不支持关闭已加载会话 | 安装生命周期补丁，或重启 Host 后在重新打开目标会话前删除 |
| 会话关闭或持久化失败 | 不继续文件删除；检查 DSH 日志，处理问题并重启 Host 后重试 |
| 部分清理失败 | 数据可能已部分删除；排除存储或 Workspace 错误后重试同一会话 |
| 请求中断或响应无效 | 结果未知；刷新核对，不能据此认为数据仍然完整 |
| 已删除，但列表刷新失败 | 点击 **重试刷新**，只重试客户端同步 |

同一 Host 内，同一会话的并发请求会合并处理。可安全重试清理，但这不等于删除具有原子性；必要步骤全部完成后才报告成功。

## 验证与限制

当前代码已有以下实测记录：

- 补丁版 Desktop 删除已打开的空闲会话：列表、日志、缓存及 Workspace 关联清理，重启后未回弹，其余对照日志哈希不变。
- 隔离 Host 验证空闲删除、活动拒绝、持久化关闭失败时保留数据，以及失败后的重启重试。
- 最新确认框使用实际客户端代码进行隔离预览，检查中文、英文长标题、活动拒绝提示和 Escape。新版排版尚未完成 Desktop 回归。

详情见 [Desktop 记录](docs/desktop-smoke-test.md)、[验收报告](docs/execution-report.md) 和 [补丁说明](patches/README.md)。文档中的历史测试数量不代表当前仓库仍提供对应测试套件。

目前仍依赖固定版本的部分内部缓存及 Workspace 接口，不保证其他 DSH 版本兼容。生命周期补丁只等待 DSH 能追踪的关闭工作和返回的 Promise，无法保证第三方脱离生命周期的后台任务已停止。本地 Desktop 补丁使用本机签名，后续官方更新可能覆盖它。

## 开发检查

```sh
npm ci
npm run check
npm run pack:check
```

CI 在 Linux/macOS、Node.js 22.19.0/24 上执行语法和 npm 打包检查。自动化测试套件及其 CI 步骤已按维护要求移除；以上命令不验证删除行为。行为验收应使用隔离临时目录。

上游接口分析及后续建议见 [源码审查](docs/upstream-audit.md)、[API 提案](docs/upstream-api-proposal.md) 和 [未提交的 Issue 草稿](docs/upstream-issue-draft.md)。

## English

Adds **Delete session** to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar with Chinese and English UI. The **1.1.0** release supports DSH **0.2.1-rc.2** only. See the [release and downloads](https://github.com/huy8000/dsh-session-delete/releases/tag/v1.1.0).

Stock DSH supports deletion of unloaded idle sessions. Deleting a loaded idle session requires the separate [lifecycle patch](patches/README.md); updating this plugin alone does not patch DSH. Running tasks, maintenance, pending input and unsupported owners are refused without forced cancellation.

Install from a local path or the Git URL above, enable the plugin, and declare `singleHost: true` in the Profile patch only when one Host exclusively uses the storage. Restart the Host afterward. Shared storage is unsupported; this setting does not detect or lock out other processes.

Deletion permanently removes recognized session logs, the current projection cache and Workspace/pin/archive records. Lock files, empty directories, project files, attachments, exports, backups and third-party data remain. Partial cleanup is retryable but not atomic. A lost response means an unknown outcome; a confirmed deletion with a failed list refresh offers refresh-only retry.

Basic checks are `npm ci`, `npm run check` and `npm run pack:check`. The automated test suite has been removed. These checks do not establish deletion correctness; see the linked acceptance records for actual runtime verification and its limits.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 huy8000

plugins.description: Self-contained Cline provider for DeepSeek Harness: free (cline-free/*) and ClinePass (cline-pass/*) models, with the x-client-type product-surface header the gateway requires.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-cline-connect

把 Cline 网关的**免费模型**（`cline-free/*`）和 **ClinePass 订阅模型**（`cline-pass/*`）接入 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)。
安装为 dsh 插件后，模型会直接出现在模型列表中，用户只需填一个 Key，无需运行任何代理服务。

## 这个插件解决什么问题

Cline 网关确实对外提供免费模型，列在 `GET /api/v1/ai/cline/recommended-models` 的 `free` 数组里。
但只用 `Authorization` 打它们是会被拒的：

```http
POST https://api.cline.bot/api/v1/chat/completions
Authorization: Bearer <key>

HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":{"code":"API_REQUEST_ERROR_CODE","message":"Error 403: cline-free/<model> is only available via Cline product surfaces. ..."}}
```

这正是官方文档那句话的服务端实现：*Free model usage is not supported through the Cline API. Free models are only available in the Cline IDE Extension and CLI.*

实测（2026-10-19）发现：**网关只校验 `x-client-type` 这个头存不存在，不校验它的值** —— `cline-cli`、`cline`、`vscode` 甚至 `bogus` 都能拿到 200。
带上这个头，免费模型立刻可用。**本插件的全部意义就是把这个头补上** —— dsh 自己不会加它（`attributionHeaders()` 只返回 `user-agent`）。

## 功能

- 自动发现并暴露 `cline-free/*` 与 `cline-pass/*` 两族模型
- 每个请求自动附带 `x-client-type: cline-cli`
- 支持流式输出、工具调用、图片与 reasoning
- 免费模型带 FREE 标记，一眼可见
- 显示账号配额（5 小时 / 每周 / 每月窗口，免费与订阅共用）
- 显示免费模型的用量（今日 / 近 7 天 / 按模型分解）
- 提供 Web 设置面板与可选的 `cline_connect_*` 工具

## 要求

- dsh（本机实测版本 `0.2.1-rc.2`）
- Node.js `>= 20.3`
- 一个 Cline API Key

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add -w github:gongstudent/dsh-cline-connect
```

安装后重启 dsh。

## 配置

### API Key

Key 在 app.cline.bot → **Settings → API Keys** 创建。
可以填在 **设置 → Cline Connect** 面板里（存入 dsh 凭据库，界面只显示掩码），也可以启动前设环境变量：

```bash
export CLINE_API_KEY=sk_xxx
```

默认凭据名是 `CLINE_API_KEY`，可在 profile 配置里改成别的。

### 配置文件

在 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml` 中覆盖默认值：

```yaml
- id: cline-connect
  config:
    apiKeyEnv: CLINE_API_KEY
    exposeTools: true
```

### 管理工具

`cline_connect_*` 工具**默认不注册**。工具定义会出现在每次请求的工具列表里，而管理只是偶尔需要，所以默认让所有对话都不必付这份开销。
需要时在**设置 → Cline Connect** 中勾选「开启工具注入（重启后生效）」，或把 `exposeTools` 设为 `true`。

设置面板不受影响 —— 面板是浏览器页面而非工具，工具关闭时仍然可用。

## 模型发现

免费模型列表**会轮换**（官方说明：offered on a rotating, limited-time basis）。
插件每次激活以及手动刷新时都会重新拉取 `recommended-models`，所以不需要等插件更新就能用上新出现的免费模型。

`recommended-models` 只给 `id/name/description/tags`，但网关自己的目录 **`GET /ai/cline/models`（无需鉴权，470 项）公开上下文窗口**：`context_length`、`top_provider.max_completion_tokens`、`architecture.input_modalities` 都在里面。插件每次扫描都会拉这份目录，按「本地名」与上游 id 对上（`cline-pass/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017` ↔ `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017`），所以**新模型上线当天就有真实窗口**，不用等插件发版。

### 新模型会自动同步哪些参数

| 参数 | 来源（优先级从高到低） | 新模型上线时 |
| - | - | - |
| 上下文窗口 `contextWindow` | 配置覆盖 → **扫描 `context_length`** → 内置表 → 快照族继承 → `defaultContextWindow`（默认 100 万） | 自动 |
| 输出上限 | 配置覆盖 → **扫描 `top_provider.max_completion_tokens`** → 内置表 | 自动 |
| 可上传的模态 | 配置覆盖 → **扫描 `architecture.input_modalities`** → 内置表 | 自动 |
| 是否支持推理 | 配置覆盖 → 内置表（**实测值**）→ 扫描 `supported_parameters` 里的 `reasoning` / `reasoning_effort` / `include_reasoning` → 路由默认 | 自动 |
| 展示名 | 配置覆盖 → 内置表（**精修标签**）→ 扫描 `name` → 模型 id | 自动 |

两处刻意的例外：**扫描实测值压过内置表**（窗口/输出/模态）—— 网关会为每个新模型重新发布这些数字，内置表只是发版那天的快照，这样上游改了窗口或图片支持，插件不用发版就能跟上；**推理能力和标签留在内置表**—— 标签是精修过的（扫描给的是 `DeepSeek: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017` 这种上游全名），推理能力是本插件在真网关实测过的，而扫描的 `supported_parameters` 说的是「这个端点接受哪些参数」，不是「这个模型会不会推理」。

### 关于「上传的文件类型」

这一版 dsh 的模态词汇表只有 **`text` 和 `image`**（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` 的 `ModelModalityMap`），附件系统也只接受 `image/png`、`image/jpeg`、`image/webp`、`image/gif` —— 所以「文件类型」目前等于「图片」，PDF / 音频 / 视频在 seam 这一层就表达不出来。插件按 `lib/catalog.js` 的 `SEAM_MODALITIES` 常量裁剪扫描到的模态（上游常报 `video` / `audio` / `file`）。等 dsh 扩展这个词汇表，改那一行常量即可，扫描拿到的数据已经在手上。

### 兜底

窗口和模态都问不到的模型（冷启动 + 无网络 + 模型比插件新），窗口按 `defaultContextWindow`、模态按**保守兜底**（当作纯文本）处理，并在面板上标记出来。

已知的实测差异：`cline-free/solar-mini4` **不支持图片输入**，其余三个支持。给它发图片时上游会返回 500（不是 4xx），插件会提前按模态拦下并给出可读错误。

## 免费模型的用量

面板里有一块「免费模型用量」，显示今日与近 7 天的 token 数、模型数与费用，以及今日按模型的分解。

### 没有「免费专属额度」这回事

上游**没有**提供免费模型的独立额度，这是实测结论而不是没做：

- `GET /users/me/plan/usage-limits` 返回的三个窗口（5 小时 / 每周 / 每月）是**账号级**的，免费与 ClinePass **共用**。加 `?modelType=cline-free` 数值完全不变（参数被忽略）。
- 不存在免费专属端点：`/users/me/limits`、`/users/me/plan/limits`、`/users/me/free-limit`、`/ai/cline/limits`、`/ai/cline/free-models` 全部 404。
- 免费模型响应里也没有任何 `x-ratelimit-*` 或 `retry-after` 头。
- Cline 官方 SDK **从不查询额度端点**；它识别额度耗尽的方式是字符串匹配 `free limit reached on model`，再从消息里解析 `try again in …`。

换句话说：**免费额度在撞到之前是不可见的**。所以面板显示的 token 用量来自按模型的用量明细，而不是某个额度百分比。

### 用量明细的判别字段

`GET /users/{id}/usages/daily` 返回按「天 × 模型」聚合的行，靠 **`aiModelTypeName`**（`cline-free` / `cline-pass` / `deepseek`）区分族别。

**不能按 `aiModelName` 前缀判断**：它有时是 id（`cline-free/nemotron-3.5-super-vl`），有时是展示名（`Mimo V2.6 Flash`），前缀匹配会静默丢行。

费用字段 `costUsd` 的单位是**微美元（1e-6 USD）**。

## ⚠️ 合规与风险

请在使用前了解以下几点：

1. **官方不鼓励这种用法。** 官方文档明确写着免费模型「not supported through the Cline API」。本插件是借用 CLI 产品面（`x-client-type: cline-cli`）来获取免费额度，**存在账号被限制的风险**。
2. **免费用量可能被用于改进模型。** 官方文档写明 free model usage *may be used to help improve model performance and quality*。敏感内容不要走免费模型。
3. **免费模型会消耗你账号的配额**，不是无限量，与 ClinePass 共用同一套窗口。
4. **列表与模型随时可能变化**，上游未列出的模型会直接 404。

## 与 dsh-cline-pass 的关系

本插件的实现以 MIT 许可的 [`dsh-cline-pass`](https://github.com/yhshzh/dsh-cline-pass) 为蓝本，目标是**替代**它（同时提供 `cline-free/*` 与 `cline-pass/*`）。

迁移时注意：

- 两者的 provider 路由名不同（本插件是 `cline-connect`），所以**可以并存**，不会互相冲突。并存期间模型选择器里会出现两个 provider 下的同名 `cline-pass/*` 模型。
- 路由名刻意不叫 `cline`：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` 的 `providers` 字典键就是 harness 路由名，如果你已经用 pi-ai 配过一个 `cline` provider 作为免费模型的临时方案，两者会在 `registerAdapter` 处撞成 `DUPLICATE_ADAPTER`。
- 切换后需要**重新选一次会话模型** —— dsh 的模型选择是按 provider+model 记录的。
- 本插件**不提供**多账号池、渠道探测/校验/钉住（`probe`/`validate`/`pin`），这是有意的取舍。

## 版本与更新

插件以 `github:` 安装时，pnpm 会把依赖钉到**一个 commit**（写在 profile 的 `pnpm-lock.yaml` 里）。这意味着：

- **装/更新任何别的插件，都可能按锁文件把本插件装回旧 commit** —— 看起来像「功能突然没了」，其实是版本回退了；
- 想升级本插件，必须显式重新解析：`pnpm update dsh-cline-connect`。

为了不用靠猜，面板里有一块**「版本与更新」**（设置 → 插件 → Cline Connect 页签底部，默认折叠）：

| 显示 | 含义 |
| - | - |
| 已安装 | 当前正在跑的这份代码的版本（读插件自己的 `package.json`） |
| 锁文件 commit | 本 profile 的 lockfile 钉住的 commit（`link:` 安装时为空） |
| 上游最新 | 上游 `main` 的 commit 与版本（`commits/main` + 该 commit 的 `package.json`） |
| 状态 | 已是最新 / 有更新 / 检查失败（带原因，不假装正常） |
| 命令 | 可复制的升级命令；优先用 dsh 自带的那份 pnpm（系统 pnpm 可能因 store 版本不同直接拒绝） |

「检查更新」按钮强制重读；平时打开面板读一次就缓存 10 分钟，失败缓存 1 分钟。检查只读 GitHub，**不装包、不重启** —— 升级仍要你执行那条命令再重启 dsh。

## 开发

本仓库只包含插件本体（`lib/`、`locale/`、bundle patch 与包元数据），**不含测试与设计文档**。

> ⚠️ **安装方式决定能不能加载。** 用 `link:`（junction）方式安装时，插件属于 dsh 的 **linked 层**：
> 只有当插件 `package.json` 的 `peerDependencies` 里**列出了**某个包名时，dsh 才会把该裸导入路由到安装目录。
> 所以 `lib/` 里用到的每个 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 都必须声明在 `peerDependencies` —— 漏一个，
> 插件就会**显示已启用、但组件状态是「未运行」**，界面空白且没有任何报错。
> 用 `github:` 方式安装（装进 profile 内部）不受这条限制。

调试时注意：`lib/` 中 `adapter.js`、`engine.js`、`index.js`、`tools.js` 会 import `@deepseek-ai/*`，
那些包只在 dsh 运行时内可解析，纯 node 下无法直接 import。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

本项目派生自 MIT 许可的 [dsh-cline-pass](https://github.com/yhshzh/dsh-cline-pass)，
`lib/` 中有部分代码源自该项目，其版权归 dsh-cline-pass contributors 所有。

[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered_by-dsh-4D6BFE?style=flat-square&logo=deepseek&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

plugins.description: Capability self-model plugin for DeepSeek Harness: measures what skills really deliver, injects the measured truth before use, and corrects skill descriptions overnight with backups and revert.
plugins.readme_text:
# Dreaming · consciousness strength

[中文](README.zh.md) | English

> Knowing what a skill can actually do *before* you execute it — that is **consciousness strength**. Dreaming raises it by measuring every skill call and correcting skill boundaries overnight, so skills are invoked precisely and tokens are not wasted on descriptions that merely *look* right.

Dreaming is a global DeepSeek Harness plugin (Host plugin + Web panel). It is not a logging plugin; it is a **capability self-model**:

- every skill load is **concurrently probed** with a cheap model call that predicts what the skill can really deliver for this task;
- what actually happened after the load is recorded (did the model follow the skill, abandon it, redo the work, how many tokens did it cost);
- at the end of the turn a **judge** compares expectation with reality and extracts reusable rules;
- each skill keeps a durable **capability belief** and a single consciousness score;
- the measured truth is injected before use (historical accuracy, boundaries, cheaper alternatives);
- a **nightly dream** revisits mismatches and safely edits skill descriptions and boundary sections (backups, journal, revertible), improving precision at the source.

## Why it exists

A skill description is a *claim*. Claims and reality often disagree:

- the description promises X, the body only covers a subset of X;
- the description is too broad, so the model loads it when it should not, and the whole body becomes context cost;
- the description is too narrow, so the model bypasses the skill and redoes the work, wasting more tokens;
- the same task keeps misusing the same skill, and nothing writes that lesson back into the description.

Dreaming closes the loop: **measure → judge → write the boundary back → measure again**. The metric is rising consciousness and falling wasted tokens, not the number of log lines.

## How it works

```
                    ┌──────────── every skill call ────────────┐
user/agent ── skill ─┤ tools/pre-execute                        │
                    │   ├─ record the task context (truncated)  │
                    │   └─ concurrent probe: a cheap LLM call   │
                    │        predicting fit / expected use /    │
                    │        pitfalls / capability gap          │
                    ├─ tools/result: record the skill body and │
                    │   the load outcome                        │
                    ├─ tools/post-execute: append measured     │
                    │   history + prediction + learned          │
                    │   boundaries to the skill result          │
                    ├─ session/event: observe later assistant/ │
                    │   tool/user events until turn end         │
                    └─ judge: expectation vs reality → score / │
                               root cause / reusable rules     │
                                    │
                     ┌──────────────┴──────────────┐
                     │ capability belief per skill  │
                     │ consciousness / calibration  │
                     │ boundary accuracy / waste    │
                     └──────────────┬──────────────┘
                                    │
              global awareness section in the system prompt
              + annotation appended to the skill result
                                    │
                         ┌──────────┴──────────┐
                         │ nightly dream (timer)│
                         │ pick mismatches →    │
                         │ reflect → edit the   │
                         │ description/boundary │
                         │ → backup + journal + │
                         │ revert               │
                         └─────────────────────┘
```

### 1. Probe — predict at load time

Inside `tools/pre-execute` the plugin registers an episode before the skill runs and starts a budgeted LLM call concurrently (default `probe.mode = 'inline'`; it uses `ctx.llm.stream` directly and does not create a sub-session or pollute the conversation). The probe returns a structured prediction:

- `fit` (0–1): whether and how well the skill fits this task;
- `expected_use`: the concrete steps the model is expected to take;
- `success_signals`: what using it correctly would look like;
- `likely_pitfalls`: the most likely traps;
- `capability_gap`: a capability the task needs that the skill may not actually provide;
- `cheaper_alternative`: a cheaper path when the skill is not needed.

> Why not a sub-agent by default: a full sub-agent's fixed prompt + tool schemas + multi-step reasoning usually costs more than the skill body it is meant to save. The probe is a single, low-temperature, structured, sampled call. `probe.mode = 'subagent'` remains available for cases that genuinely need an agent-shaped observer.

### 2. Observe the real outcome

`tools/result` records the skill load; `session/event` collects a bounded trace from the load point: assistant text, tool-call sequence (name/outcome/summary), user corrections, and the `turn/end` reason. The window closes at the same turn's `turn/end`, or after `observe.maxTurnExtensionMs` / `observe.maxEvents`. Closed sessions are never read again and the window does not stay in memory.

### 3. Judge — expectation vs reality

After the turn, one cheap judge call produces:

- `score` (0–100) and `verdict` (`matched` / `partial` / `missed` / `misapplied`);
- `predictionAccuracy`: agreement between prediction and reality;
- `capabilityGap`: difference between what the description claims and what was delivered;
- `mismatches`, `rootCause` (`description` / `instructions` / `selection` / `user` / `execution`);
- `reusableRule`: a rule that can be reused next time;
- `cost.wastedEstimate`: a conservative estimate of wasted tokens.

### 4. Capability belief and consciousness

Each skill keeps a belief: load count, verdict distribution, fit history, cost, learned boundaries. Core metrics:

| Metric | Definition | Question it answers |
|---|---|---|
| `fitAccuracy` | `1 − Brier score` (predicted fit vs. actual success) | Does it predict *itself* accurately? |
| `boundaryAccuracy` | `1 − share of judged calls with a capability gap` | Is its stated boundary accurate? |
| `precision` | `1 − misapplied / judged` (judged calls only) | When it was called, was it on topic? |
| `consciousness` | `100 × (0.45·fitAccuracy + 0.30·boundaryAccuracy + 0.25·precision)` | The combined consciousness score |
| `wasteRate` | wasted tokens / loaded skill tokens | How much did it waste? |
| `confidence` | `<3 / <10 / ≥10 judged` → low / medium / high | How trustworthy is the score? |

> No fake high score with few samples: `confidence = low` is reported, and both the panel and the model-facing text say so.

### 5. Injection — give the truth before use

- **A global system-prompt section**, `Dreaming · capability awareness`, appears only when there is enough evidence, at most `prompt.maxSkills` lines, explicitly marked as observed tendency and not overriding the skill's own instructions.
- **Skill-result annotation**: after a skill loads, up to `prompt.annotationMaxChars` characters are appended to the result:
  - the skill's measured fit accuracy / consciousness / waste rate;
  - this call's predicted use, pitfalls and cheaper alternative (when the probe finishes inside `probe.attachDeadlineMs`);
  - the learned “not for / preconditions”.

The model sees this after reading the skill body and before acting, so it can adjust immediately.

### 6. Dream — correct the capability description overnight

`dream.time` (default `03:30`, local time zone, configurable IANA zone) triggers a run; catch-up and jitter are supported. Each run:

1. selects recent (within `caseWindowDays`) `missed` / `misapplied` / low-score cases, grouped by skill (at most `maxCasesPerSkill` cases per skill, `maxSkillsPerRun` skills per run);
2. builds a bounded dream pack: the current skill file, the current description, learned boundaries, compressed cases;
3. asks the dreamer for a structured proposal: a `description` edit, a `body` capability-boundary section, reusable rules, confidence;
4. applies

plugins.description: Liuguang 琉光 — DeepSeek Harness skin/theme (DSH): liquid glass + Soviet constructivism, switchable; personalization panel, CSS skin packs, whale-girl pet.
plugins.readme_text:
# 琉光 · Liuguang

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-theme-liuguang?label=npm&color=c0301c)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-theme-liuguang)
[![stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/ShokouP/dsh-theme-liuguang?label=stars&color=c0301c)](https://github.com/ShokouP/dsh-theme-liuguang/stargazers)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/ShokouP/dsh-theme-liuguang?label=license)](LICENSE)
[![awesome-dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/awesome-dsh--plugin-theme-c0301c)](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)

**给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的两套设计语言皮肤：液态玻璃 / 苏联构成主义，随时切换。**

English: **Liuguang** is a skin for the DeepSeek Harness GUI with two switchable design languages — liquid glass and Soviet constructivism — plus a personalization panel, drop-in CSS skin packs and a whale-girl desktop pet.

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-theme-liuguang
```

![Liuguang demo](screenshots/demo.gif)

> **包名（装的就是它）**：`dsh-theme-liuguang`
>
> **别名 / 搜这些词都能找到我**：
> DSH 皮肤 · DSH 主题 · DeepSeek Harness 皮肤 · DeepSeek Harness 主题插件 ·
> dsh skin · dsh theme · dsh-plugin · liquid glass skin · glassmorphism ·
> Soviet constructivism theme · constructivist UI · 液态玻璃皮肤 · 苏联构成主义主题 ·
> 鲸鱼娘桌宠 · desktop pet skin · 琉光主题

| 液态玻璃 | 苏联构成主义 | 个性化面板 |
|---|---|---|
| ![](screenshots/design-glass.png) | ![](screenshots/design-constructivist.png) | ![](screenshots/design-panel.png) |

> 截图里左侧会话栏做了模糊处理，避免泄露个人会话标题。

---

## 两套设计语言，随时切换

右下角 `✦` → **外观 → 设计语言**，点一下即时切换，不用重启、不用刷新：

| 液态玻璃 / Liquid Glass | 苏联构成主义 / Constructivism |
|---|---|
| 半透明磨砂、内部发光玻璃珠、细噪点、跟随指针的镜面高光 | 米色纸面 + 血红 + 墨黑，硬直角、粗边框、实心偏移投影、海报式标题下划线 |
| 三套底色：**墨银**（暖灰黑+香槟金）/ **深海**（藏蓝+青）/ **暖砂**（褐黑+琥珀） | 明暗两种海报：米色正片 / 墨黑夜版 |
| 强调色可任意自定义 | 红/赭/墨等套色，固定印刷感 |

**两套语言各自拥有独立的选项——不是同一组滑杆换皮：**

- **液态玻璃**：底色（墨银/深海/暖砂）、强调色（预设或取色器）、磨砂 0–60px、通透、圆角、动效。
- **构成主义**（都是干活用的，不是贴纸）：**纸张**（米白/灰白/牛皮/蓝图纸）、**套色**（血红/朱砂/赭石/普鲁士蓝/墨）、**版心**（宽/中/窄）、**字号**（小/标准/大，改的是正文实际字号）、**编号**（无 / 01 / 02 / 03 小角标）、**印章**（时钟 / 模型 / 关）、**状态**（自动 / 关）、**指标**（开 / 关）。

> 构成主义里红色只做**状态与层级信号**：选中会话、当前焦点（输入卡聚焦时边框与投影转红）、主按钮、印章；没有装饰性的红色色块。
>
> 运行数据做成**输入框左侧的一栏页边注**（右对齐、红色竖标朝向输入框）：`630 步 · 15 轮` / `233 tok/s` / `264 M tok` / `99% 缓存命中`（有上下文文本时再加一行 `xx% 上下文`）。只显示能从界面文本里**确认标到标签**的数字——曾经用"取最后一个百分号"猜上下文，把缓存命中率印到了上下文那一行，已改成按标签匹配，解析不到就不显示。打开个性化面板时整栏自动隐藏。
>
> 另一个切合干活的细节：**状态 = 顶栏斜纹**（只在 agent 跑任务时出现并缓慢移动，停下就静止消失）。

![构成主义控制面板](screenshots/constructivist-controls.png)

### 预览图（1280×630，可用于分享/OG）

![液态玻璃预览](screenshots/og-glass.png)
![构成主义预览](screenshots/og-constructivist.png)

## 功能

- **设计语言切换**：玻璃 ↔ 构成主义，即时生效并记忆。
- **投放式皮肤包**：把 `~/.dsh/liuguang-packs/<id>/`（`pack.json` + `theme.css`）丢进去，面板里立刻出现；坏包只影响自己。见 [docs/skin-packs.md](docs/skin-packs.md)。
- **个性化面板**：外观（玻璃：底色/强调色/磨砂/通透/圆角/动效；构成主义：纸张/套色/网格/编号/印章/母题/字距）、桌宠（显示/大小/话痨/7 种表情试玩/归位）、关于（版本/署名/恢复默认）。
- **鲸鱼娘桌宠**：7 种表情，可拖拽、悬停变开心、点击随机反应并说一句、90 秒无操作犯困。
- **可验证的颜色**：配色在 OKLCH 中定义并由脚本转 sRGB，`npm run check:contrast` 按 WCAG 校验全部文字/UI 配对。见 [docs/digest.md](docs/digest.md)。
- **一键撤销**：删依赖 + 注销 bundle，刷新即回原版；不碰 `app.asar`。

## 安装

### 方式一：npm（推荐，一行装）

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-theme-liuguang?label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-theme-liuguang)

```bat
npm i -g pnpm
dsh plugin add dsh-theme-liuguang
```

安装后**重启一次 DSH**，右下角出现 `✦` 即为成功。

卸载：`dsh plugin remove dsh-theme-liuguang`

### 方式二：从 GitHub 直接装（npm 不可用时的等价路径，已实测）

```bat
npm i -g pnpm
dsh plugin add github:ShokouP/dsh-theme-liuguang
```

### 方式三：本仓库脚本（开发/本机）

```bat
:: 1. 首次安装：把皮肤注册进当前 DSH profile（创建 junction + 写入 bundle 注册）
D:\yangchengcup\ui\apply.cmd

:: 2. 重启一次 DSH（首次加载插件必须）
D:\yangchengcup\ui\restart-dsh.cmd
```

撤销：

```bat
D:\yangchengcup\ui\revert.cmd                    :: 移除皮肤
D:\yangchengcup\ui\revert.cmd -RestoreBackup     :: 连 profile 的 patch 一起还原
```

多 profile：`apply.cmd -ProfileName web`；临时 profile 用于测试：`apply.cmd -ProfileName lab`。

> 已发布到 npm：<https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-theme-liuguang>

## 发版（全自动）

发布走 **npm trusted publishing（OIDC）**：不需要 token，也不需要 OTP。

```bat
:: 1. 改版本号（根 package.json 与 liuguang/package.json 保持一致）
:: 2. 提交并打 tag，push
git commit -am "release: v0.3.1"
git tag v0.3.1
git push origin main --tags
```

tag 推送后 `.github/workflows/publish.yml` 会自动：

1. 校验 tag 与 `package.json` 版本一致；
2. `npm publish --access public --provenance`（OIDC 证明身份，产出带 provenance 的包）；
3. `npm view` 自检；
4. 创建 GitHub Release 并附上 `.tgz`。

一次性配置（只需做一次）：

- npm 包页面 → **Settings → Trusted publishing → GitHub Actions**：
  owner `ShokouP`、repo `dsh-theme-liuguang`、workflow `publish.yml`；
- 本机 `gh auth refresh -s workflow`，让 `gh` 能推送 workflow 文件。

## 目录

```
ui/
├─ liuguang/                 主包：宿主注入 + 样式 + 面板/桌宠
│  ├─ lib/index.js           index-inject、/liuguang/theme.css、/liuguang/packs
│  ├─ lib/liuguang.css       全部视觉（玻璃 + 构成主义 + 面板 + 桌宠）
│  ├─ src/overlay.js         React 覆盖层（slot: shell.overlay）
│  └─ tools/palette.mjs      OKLCH → sRGB + WCAG 审计
├─ liuguang-browser/         浏览器面：overlay 挂载、/liuguang/ping、表情图
├─ examples/packs/mist/      示例皮肤包（樱雾）
├─ docs/                     皮肤包格式、生态消化笔记
└─ screenshots/              版本截图（侧栏已模糊）
```

## 设计说明

- 只依赖 `--dsw-*` 设计令牌与语义化钩子（`[data-composer-card]`、`[data-sidebar-right-panel][data-sidebar-right-open]`、`role=treeitem[aria-selected]` 等），**不依赖 CSS-module 哈希类名**，DSH 升级不会静默失效。
- Windows 标题栏模式下侧栏关闭 `backdrop-filter`（否则 fixed 的标题栏按钮会被重新锚定）。
- 输入卡不套 `backdrop-filter`、聚焦不做 `transform`，避免把 `/`、`@` 弹层困进层叠上下文。

## English

**Liuguang** is a skin for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) GUI with **two design languages** —
*Liquid Glass* (translucent surfaces, inner-lit glass beads, pointer specular) and *Soviet Constructivism*
(cream/ink/red poster geometry, hard rules, offset shadows) — switchable from the `✦` panel.
It ships a personalization panel, drop-in CSS skin packs, a whale-girl desktop pet with 7 expressions,
and an OKLCH + WCAG-audited palette. Install with `apply.cmd`, undo with `revert.cmd`; nothing is patched inside `app.asar`.

## 许可

- 代码：**MIT**（见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)）。
- 宠物立绘：社区二创，**CC BY-NC-SA 4.0**（署名 上善无形 / ZipZipPipe，见 [assets/pet/CREDITS.md](assets/pet/CREDITS.md)），不属于 MIT 范围，禁止商用。
- 与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系。

plugins.readme_text:
DSH BTW

主任务继续，旁边随时问一句。
DeepSeek Harness 插件

简体中文 · English

开始使用 · 完整文档 · 反馈

## 快速开始 **适用环境：** DSH **0.2.1-rc.2**, Node.js **22.19+**. 旁聊使用现有模型服务并产生正常用量，不执行工具。记录仅保存在当前窗口内存，刷新后消失。 ### 1. 安装 打开实际使用的 DSH 实例，在 **插件 → ＋ 添加插件** 中粘贴： ```text https://github.com/gulagala001/dsh-btw/releases/download/v0.1.2-dsh.0.2.1-rc.2/gulagala001-dsh-btw-0.1.2-dsh.0.2.1-rc.2.tgz ``` 等当前任务结束后，按宿主提示启用或完整重启该实例，沿用原 profile 与数据。其他宿主、升级和卸载见[安装指南](docs/install.zh.md) · [SHA256SUMS](https://github.com/gulagala001/dsh-btw/releases/download/v0.1.2-dsh.0.2.1-rc.2/SHA256SUMS). ### 2. 先试这一件事 先在主会话发送过一条消息，再输入： ```text /btw 用两句话解释刚才方案里最重要的取舍。 ``` **成功标志：** 输入框上方出现旁聊回复；主任务继续运行，旁聊不写入主对话历史。 ## 不打断主任务的旁聊 - 输入 `/btw 问题` 直接提问；只输入 `/btw` 打开弹窗与历史列表。 - 弹窗支持 Markdown、代码复制和继续提问，使用当前主会话已有上下文。 - 停止旁聊只取消旁聊请求；Esc 或关闭按钮仅隐藏窗口，主任务继续。 上下文快照包含已完成的工具结果，不包含正在生成的主回复。请求保留主会话的消息前缀、上次实际模型配置、工具声明及缓存关联，只追加旁聊内容；实际缓存命中由模型服务决定。旁聊不执行工具，也不写入主对话历史。 ## 常见问题
旁聊记录能保留多久？ 按主会话隔离，最多保留最近 20 条。记录只在当前窗口内存中，刷新、关闭窗口或停用插件后消失。
为什么首次提问或带附件时不能直接旁聊？ 需先在主会话发送过消息以建立上下文。旁聊仅接收文字；输入框带附件时会保留草稿并提示，不丢弃附件。
关闭弹窗后回答还在继续？ 关闭只隐藏界面。使用弹窗内停止操作取消该旁聊；不会停止主任务。
## 兼容、开发与许可 匹配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2、Cordis 4.0.5。已验证 macOS 原生 Web 客户端；Windows、Linux 与 Electron 桌面外壳未完成实机验证。安装标识为 `@gulagala001/dsh-btw`，从固定 GitHub Release 分发。 ```bash npm ci npm run build npm test ``` 前端使用 DSH 原生组件和输入扩展，后端读取只读上下文快照并发起独立流式请求。采用 [MIT](LICENSE)。 ## 文档与支持 | 我想做什么 | 去哪里 | | --- | --- | | 安装、升级、卸载 | [安装指南](docs/install.zh.md) | | 了解使用方法与边界 | [使用文档](docs/install.zh.md) | | 查看版本变化 | [Releases](https://github.com/gulagala001/dsh-btw/releases) | | 反馈问题 | [Issues](https://github.com/gulagala001/dsh-btw/issues) | 反馈时请提供完整 DSH／插件版本、实际入口、最小复现步骤，以及预期和实际表现；日志与截图先移除私人数据。
